title: League of Legends Team Voice could transform Solo Queue forever… with one condition
summary: League of Legends Team Voice could transform Solo Queue forever… with one condition  Esports Insider
content:
Davide Xu is a freelance writer at Esports Insider focused on League of Legends esports. He covers everything inside and outside the Rift—especially when it comes to European and Asian competitive scenes. With a finance background and a multicultural lens, he loves talking about business as much as macro.

Olivia Richman is a seasoned esports journalist who has worked with Inven Global, Esports Illustrated, Esports.gg, and more. As an editor and writer at Esports Insider, she loves telling unique esports stories, especially within the FGC. When not working and gaming, Olivia loves collecting Kirby plush, eating sushi, and driving her cars at the track.

For 17 years,League of Legendshas asked players to coordinate in-game solely on pings and hurried messages typed in between clicks. Now, this could all change.

Earlier this March,Riot Games confirmedthat it was exploring the implementation of Team Voice to the game, extending communication beyond premade parties.

While the feature hasn’t been released just yet,recent leaksalso reported that the dev team is working on a Voicemod integration, meaning that players can alter their natural voices to disguise themselves.

On paper, this is an important addition, as it would reduce potential harm caused by discriminatory behavior. That said, it still won’t address the underlying issue: the potential toxicity that comes with such a powerful tool.

title: T1, Gen.G, Dplus in the Lol Worlds 2026 qualification: LCK playoffs stream, schedule, results
summary: T1, Gen.G, Dplus in the Lol Worlds 2026 qualification: LCK playoffs stream, schedule, results  Esports.gg
content:
From the Mushroom Kingdom to Summoner’s Rift, Eugene actively explores the multidimensional world of video games and occasionally writes about his discoveries. He is fascinated by gaming competitions, believing that…

League of Legends (LoL) teams in Korea are traditionally the favorites for the Worlds trophy. In the regional playoffs, they flex their competitive muscles and battle for three qualification spots.

The long and exciting 2026 season in LoL Champions Korea (LCK) comes to an end with double-elimination playoff brackets. The top 6 teams of this strongest League of Legends esports region clash to reach the top 3 and advance to the main event of the year, LoL Worlds 2026.

All eyes are onT1players, sure. They are the reigning World Champions! To potentially extend their three-title streak, Faker and company should make it through a few highly intense rounds.

Dplusare the Esports Worlds Cup 2026 winners, and it’s interesting to check out their current state after such success.Gen.Gdominated the LCK scene in 2025 and reached the top 3 at the First Stand tournament and the EWC 2026. Not qualifying for the Mid-Season Invitational 2026 (MSI 2026) was a big disappointment for Gen.G fans

Hanwha Life Esportswon the MSI 2026 and guaranteed themselves Worlds 2026 qualification. Still, the expectations are high for them. Facing T1, Gen.G, and Dplus KIA is a nice test of true power.
